dossier.summary: Marlowe Dental Partners runs eleven general dentistry clinics in one metro area, with a shared back office for billing and scheduling.

peers.peer_group: multi-site health care providers with 50 to 250 people

data.headline: How mature are Marlowe's clinic operations?
data.intro: Priya, every new clinic adds a copy of the same routines. Three minutes shows which ones are written down well enough to copy again.

steps.title: Write down the ten routines every clinic repeats
steps.body: Opening, patient check-in, sterilization logs, handoffs to billing. One page each, owned by one person, so the eleventh clinic runs like the first.

steps.title: Pick five numbers every clinic manager reads weekly
steps.body: Chair utilization, no-shows, claims sent late and similar figures. Put them in one view so a manager sees their clinic next to the others without asking the back office.

steps.title: Move appointment reminders and claim checks to rules
steps.body: Reminders, recall lists and claim checks repeat all day in every clinic. Let software run them and keep people for the exceptions.

steps.title: Name one owner for clinic improvement
steps.body: One person with a short backlog and two hours a week. With a new clinic every few months, it keeps the fixes from one clinic reaching the others.
